# High Point Realty & Auction

> Kentucky's premier real estate and auction company. Full-service brokerage and professional auction services across Central and Eastern Kentucky.

High Point Realty & Auction is based in Richmond, Kentucky and serves Madison, Estill, Rockcastle, Jackson, Lee, Breathitt, and surrounding counties. The company offers residential and commercial real estate representation as well as onsite and online property auctions conducted by licensed Kentucky auctioneers.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://highpointky.com/): Overview of services, team, counties served, and featured video content
- [Current Auctions](https://highpointky.com/current-auctions): Live and upcoming property auctions conducted by licensed Kentucky auctioneers via HiBid platform
- [Listings](https://highpointky.com/listings): Current real estate listings for sale across Central and Eastern Kentucky
- [Past Auctions](https://highpointky.com/past-auctions): Archive of completed auctions with results and recorded high bids
- [About](https://highpointky.com/about): Team profiles, company history, and credentials
- [Contact](https://highpointky.com/contact): Contact information, office address, and agent directory
